headline: Thousands Protest in Lisbon Demanding Wage Hikes Amid Rising Living Costs
summary: Thousands of workers gathered in Lisbon during a union-led protest organized by the CGTP. Demonstrators demanded higher salaries and increased pensions to counter elevated cost-of-living pressures.
why: Labor union actions in Portugal reflect broader European inflation concerns and influence domestic wage negotiations.

impacts.name: Portugal
impacts.why: Labor demonstrations signal ongoing wage pressure across the Portuguese domestic economy.
